sn22.95:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā ayujjhāyaṃ viharati gaṅgāya nadiyā tīre.
sn22.95:2.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave ayaṃ gaṅgā nadī mahantaṃ pheṇapiṇḍaṃ āvaheyya tamenaṃ cakkhumā puriso passeyya nijjhāyeyya yoniso upaparikkheyya tassa passato nijjhāyato yoniso upaparikkhato rittakaññeva khāyeyya tucchakaññeva khāyeyya asārakaññeva khāyeyya kiñhi siyā bhikkhave pheṇapiṇḍe sāro.
sn22.95:2.2: evameva kho bhikkhave yaṅkiñci rūpaṃ atītānāgatapaccuppannaṃ …pe… yaṃ dūre santike vā taṃ bhikkhu passati nijjhāyati yoniso upaparikkhati tassa passato nijjhāyato yoniso upaparikkhato rittakaññeva khāyati tucchakaññeva khāyati asārakaññeva khāyati kiñhi siyā bhikkhave rūpe sāro.
sn22.95:3.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave saradasamaye thullaphusitake deve vassante udake udakapubbuḷaṃ uppajjati ceva nirujjhati ca tamenaṃ cakkhumā puriso passeyya nijjhāyeyya yoniso upaparikkheyya tassa passato nijjhāyato yoniso upaparikkhato rittakaññeva khāyeyya tucchakaññeva khāyeyya asārakaññeva khāyeyya kiñhi siyā bhikkhave udakapubbuḷe sāro.
sn22.95:3.2: evameva kho bhikkhave yā kāci vedanā atītānāgatapaccuppannā …pe… yā dūre santike vā taṃ bhikkhu passati nijjhāyati yoniso upaparikkhati tassa passato nijjhāyato yoniso upaparikkhato rittakaññeva khāyati tucchakaññeva khāyati asārakaññeva khāyati kiñhi siyā bhikkhave vedanāya sāro.
sn22.95:4.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave gimhānaṃ pacchime māse ṭhite majjhantike kāle marīci phandati tamenaṃ cakkhumā puriso passeyya nijjhāyeyya yoniso upaparikkheyya tassa passato nijjhāyato yoniso upaparikkhato rittakaññeva khāyeyya …pe… kiñhi siyā bhikkhave marīcikāya sāro.
sn22.95:4.2: evameva kho bhikkhave yā kāci saññā …pe…
sn22.95:5.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso sāratthiko sāragavesī sārapariyesanaṃ caramāno tiṇhaṃ kudhāriṃ ādāya vanaṃ paviseyya so tattha passeyya mahantaṃ kadalikkhandhaṃ ujuṃ navaṃ akukkujakajātaṃ tamenaṃ mūle chindeyya mūle chetvā agge chindeyya agge chetvā pattavaṭṭiṃ vinibbhujjeyya so tattha pattavaṭṭiṃ vinibbhujjanto phegguṃpi nādhigaccheyya kuto sāraṃ tamenaṃ cakkhumā puriso passeyya nijjhāyeyya yoniso upaparikkheyya tassa passato nijjhāyato yoniso upaparikkhato rittakaññeva khāyeyya tucchakaññeva khāyeyya asārakaññeva khāyeyya kiñhi siyā bhikkhave kadalikkhandhe sāro.
sn22.95:5.2: evameva kho bhikkhave ye keci saṅkhārā atītānāgatapaccuppannā …pe… ye dūre santike vā taṃ bhikkhu passati nijjhāyati yoniso. upaparikkhati tassa passato nijjhāyato yoniso upaparikkhato rittakaññeva khāyati tucchakaññeva khāyati asārakaññeva khāyati kiñhi siyā bhikkhave saṅkhāresu sāro.
sn22.95:6.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave māyākāro vā māyākārantevāsī vā cātummahāpathe māyaṃ vidaṃseyya tamenaṃ cakkhumā puriso passeyya nijjhāyeyya yoniso upaparikkheyya tassa passato nijjhāyato yoniso upaparikkhato rittakaññeva khāyeyya tucchakaññeva khāyeyya asārakaññeva khāyeyya kiñhi siyā bhikkhave māyāya sāro.
sn22.95:6.2: evameva kho bhikkhave yaṅkiñci vaññāṇaṃ atītānāgatapaccuppannaṃ …pe… yaṃ dūre santike vā taṃ bhikkhu passati nijjhāyati yoniso upaparikkhati tassa passato nijjhāyato yoniso upaparikkhato rittakaññeva khāyati tucchakaññeva khāyati asārakaññeva khāyati kiñhi siyā bhikkhave viññāṇe sāro.
sn22.95:7.1: evaṃ passaṃ bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako rūpasmiṃpi nibbindati vedanāyapi. saññāyapi. saṅkhāresupi. viññāṇasmiṃpi nibbindati
sn22.95:7.2: nibbindaṃ virajjati virāgā vimuccati. vimuttasmiṃ vimuttamiti ñāṇaṃ hoti …pe…
sn22.95:8.2: idaṃ vatvāna sugato athāparaṃ etadavoca satthā
